our approach can be seen as a modular method for embodied instruction following that can be trained with less data than previous methods and that can further be improved with low-level instructions.
we propose a modular approach for embodied instruction following with a semantic map and a search policy that achieves SOTA performance without expert trajectories or low level instructions.

the explicit spatial memory and the semantic search policy can serve as a strong and general representation for state tracking and guidance, and can be used to achieve SOTA performance on embodied instruction following tasks.

modular approaches can be more effective than end-to-end approaches for instruction-following, especially when the instruction language is complex.
